name: ship
description: Spec, review and land in every session: specifying writes a validated design spec, gating-reviews runs one reviewing-code pass and stamps the tree, landing commits exactly that tree. A spec gate refuses the first edit no valid spec covers; a commit gate refuses raw git commit and push. Needs node and git. Parity gap: only Claude Code runs the qa-swarm review lanes in parallel through its Workflow tool; other agents run them one after another.

hooks.description: Refuses the first edit in a git checkout until a valid design spec under ~/.local/state/ship/specs names it; a retry in the same session goes through.
Refuses a raw git commit or git push, pointing to the landing skill, whose land.ts commits the stamped tree. Catches accidents, not an agent set on getting around it.
